relevance_rank_note: APOE4/4 vs APOE3/3 targeted-replacement mice: Rab5a early-endosome number, size and area fraction in cortical neurons by age; an endosome-morphology surrogate for receptor recycling, null at 6 and 12 months, increased at 18 and 25 months.

description: In 18-month-old APOE4/4 targeted-replacement mice, entorhinal cortex pyramidal neurons had more Rab5a-positive early endosomes per cell than in APOE3/3 mice.
quote: In APOE4/4 mice, we observed an increase in the mean number (8.5 ± 0.5 APOE3/3, 11.7 ± 0.8 APOE4/4 particles/cell; p = 0.0007; Figure 4B)
summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (more Rab5a+ early endosomes per entorhinal neuron, 18 months)
system: Mouse, human APOE targeted-replacement (Sullivan et al.) APOE4/4 vs APOE3/3, 18 months old, roughly equal males and females, two colonies; entorhinal cortex pyramidal neurons, Rab5a immunofluorescence (sc-309) with Nissl border, 100x, genotype-blinded ImageJ particle analysis per neuron; 118 neurons from 7 APOE3/3 mice vs 85 neurons from 6 APOE4/4 mice; Student's t-test. Aged (18 months).
human_check: Effect read off the Fig 4B Rab5a bars (APOE3 ~8.5, APOE4 ~11.7, matching the printed means 8.5 and 11.7); the authors print means, not a percent. n = 7 APOE3/3 and 6 APOE4/4 mice (118 and 85 neurons); the t-test unit (neuron or mouse) is not stated. CatD bars in the same panel not entered (lysosome, H5).

description: Rab5a area fraction of the cell (early-endosome volume proxy) was higher in entorhinal cortex neurons of 18-month-old APOE4/4 than APOE3/3 mice.
quote: area fraction (0.6 ± 0.05% APOE3/3, 0.8 ± 0.07% APOE4/4 of cell area; p = 0.02; Figure 4D)
summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (larger Rab5a+ area fraction in entorhinal neurons, 18 months)
system: Mouse, human APOE targeted-replacement (Sullivan et al.) APOE4/4 vs APOE3/3, 18 months old, roughly equal males and females, two colonies; entorhinal cortex pyramidal neurons, Rab5a immunofluorescence (sc-309) with Nissl border, 100x, genotype-blinded ImageJ particle analysis per neuron; 118 neurons from 7 APOE3/3 mice vs 85 neurons from 6 APOE4/4 mice; Student's t-test. Aged (18 months).
human_check: Effect read off Fig 4D Rab5a bars (APOE3 ~0.6%, APOE4 ~0.8%, matching printed means). n = 7 vs 6 mice; t-test unit not stated.

description: In 18-month-old mice, cingulate cortex neurons of APOE4/4 mice had greater early-endosome number per neuron than APOE3/3 mice.
quote: an increase in mean early endosome number (an increase of 30.5 ± 4.0%; Figure 5B), size (33.5 ± 8.0%; Figure 5C), and area fraction (70.1 ± 4.8%; Figure 5D) was seen in the 18 month-old APOE4/4 mice as compared to APOE3/3 controls
summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (more Rab5a+ early endosomes per neuron, cingulate, 18 months)
system: Mouse, human APOE targeted-replacement (Sullivan et al.) APOE4/4 vs APOE3/3, 18 months old, roughly equal males and females, two colonies; cingulate cortex neurons, Rab5a immunofluorescence, genotype-blinded ImageJ particle analysis per neuron, values normalised to the APOE3/3 mean at each age; 267 neurons (APOE3/3) and 286 neurons (APOE4/4) from 8 mice per genotype; Student's t-test. Aged.
human_check: Percent increase printed in Results (mean ± SEM of the increase). P from the *** star over the 18-month bars in Fig 5B, legend key ***p < 0.001; no exact P printed. n = 8 mice per genotype (267 vs 286 neurons); t-test unit not stated.
